Method of Attack: Ransomware infection locking company servers and production database, demanding ransom for unlocking systems; Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS)
Discoverer: Austrian Federal Criminal Police Office (Bundeskriminalamt, BK)
Attack Vector: Ransomware purchased from Dark Web marketplace AlphaBay
Indicators of Compromise: Philadelphia ransomware on sale on AlphaBay Dark Web marketplace starting at $389
